description:
Implement a late fee policy for Northwind Traders in Manager.io.

1. Create a new Income account named 'Late Fees Collected' in the Chart of Accounts.
2. Create a Non-inventory Item named 'Late Fee' with Code 'LATE' and Unit Price '50.00'. Link this item to the 'Late Fees Collected' income account.
3. Create a new Sales Invoice for customer 'Alfreds Futterkiste'. Add the 'Late Fee' item to the invoice (ensure you select the item, do not just type the description). Set the invoice date to today.

Credentials: Username 'administrator', no password.
